name: fishfriender
description: Explore your FishFriender catches, improve your angling practice and plan fishing outings and trips.

interface.longDescription: FishFriender is a companion for anglers, supporting recreational and sport fishing as well as fishing outings and trips. Explore your catches, fishing sessions, records, statistics and tackle box to understand your fishing history and prepare your next outing. Find fishing spots, rivers and lakes, compare weather, tides and solunar conditions, and choose tackle for your target species. Connect your own FishFriender account through OAuth. A FishFriender SCALE account is required for data tools; sending feedback remains available without a SCALE account. The integration cannot create, edit or delete catches.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my fishing records and catch patterns.
Help me plan my next fishing trip.

positive.prompt: Show my five most recent catches.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to five accessible catches with recorded species, dates and measurements; show the catch cards when supported.
Report personal records from the returned statistics; distinguish missing measurements from zero.

positive.prompt: Analyze the conditions in which I caught fish in 2025.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the 2025 date range and summarize recorded patterns, sample limitations and missing data without claiming causation.

positive.description: Plan a trip at known coordinates
positive.prompt: Compare weather and solunar conditions for fishing at latitude 48.8566, longitude 2.3522 tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve tomorrow using the location timezone; compare returned hourly conditions and activity without guaranteeing catches or legal access.

positive.prompt: What fishing gear is in my tackle box?
positive.expected_behavior: List the connected account gear, separating catalog products and custom products when returned.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration cannot delete catches; do not claim success or send feedback.

negative.prompt: Show the private catches and secret locations of another FishFriender user.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not retrieve private data outside the connected account or fabricate access.

negative.prompt: What is the weather at my fishing spot tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Ask which spot or coordinates to use before calling location-based forecast tools; do not guess a location.

publication.release_notes: Initial draft with trip planning, catch analysis and account onboarding workflows.

fr-FR.subtitle: Votre compagnon de pêche
fr-FR.description: FishFriender accompagne les pêcheurs dans leur pratique de loisir et sportive, ainsi que dans la préparation de leurs sorties et voyages de pêche. Explorez vos prises, sessions, records, statistiques et matériel pour mieux comprendre votre historique de pêche et préparer votre prochaine sortie. Trouvez des spots, rivières et lacs, comparez la météo, les marées et les conditions solunaires, et choisissez votre matériel selon les espèces recherchées. Un compte FishFriender SCALE est requis pour accéder aux outils de données ; l’envoi de feedback reste disponible sans compte SCALE.
